clues.text: Standing 75 feet tall and reaching speeds of 45 mph, this coaster takes riders through just a single inversion.
This classic attraction was manufactured by Schwarzkopf and opened to the public in 1977.
To take a ride on this coaster, you'll need to visit the state of Pennsylvania.
Upon its debut, this coaster made amusement park history as only the third modern roller coaster in the world to feature a vertical loop.
The name of this ride is an alliterative, playful rhyme combining an exaggerated slang term for something truly marvelous with a word for an inversion.

evidence.quote: '''SooperDooperLooper''' is a [[steel]] [[roller coaster]] located at [[Hersheypark]] in Hershey, Pennsylvania, USA.
It was built by [[Schwarzkopf]] and opened as the third modern roller coaster to feature a [[vertical loop]].
